decisions.reason: As a close-to-core bulk container with its own page in a growing market, it likely has low incremental carrying cost and enough uncertainty upside to justify staying on the market.
As an add-on to the established bulk-container offer that was launched with dedicated web presentation, it is a relatively cheap option to retain unless clearer negative demand evidence appears.

The take-back service fits the firm's strategic move toward reusable service-based packaging, but its lighter website presence and potentially higher operating complexity make it somewhat more at risk than the physical products.
